title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is given as sum{i ext{=1}}{N}{3*theta_0-tip_i*log{theta_0}}. Your task is to find the derivative of this function with respect to $$\theta_0$$.

title: Derivative of Logarithm
text: Recall that the derivative of log{x} with respect to $$x$$ is $$\frac{1}{x}$$. This will be useful when differentiating the term involving log{theta_0}.

title: Differentiating the Objective Function
text: Differentiate each term in the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$. The derivative of $$3\theta_0$$ is $$3$$, and the derivative of -tip_i*log{theta_0} is $$\frac{-tip_i}{\theta_0}$$.

title: Compute the Derivative
text: Combine the derivatives of each term to find the overall derivative of the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$.
